note: Tagetes is listed Do not Feed and is explicitly distinguished from edible Calendula marigolds.
Sunflower is listed Feed in Moderation. This record is used conservatively for the master sunflower-leaf item and does not create a high-proportion staple recommendation.
Leaves and unripe fruit are described as toxic and should not be fed; ripe fruit is also not recommended as routine food because it is sugary, low in calcium, high in phosphorus and low in fibre.
